5. Frequent low-cost flights contribute heavily to __________ 
emissions. 
a) carbon 
b) economic 
c) social 
d) cultural 
 
Exercise 2: Word Pairs (Collocation Building) 
Match the words in Column A with their best partner in Column B to form 
natural academic collocations. 
Column A Column B 
1. Cheap a. impact 
2. Budget b. airlines 
3. Environmental c. options 
4. Travel d. concerns 
5. Ticket e. costs 
 
Exercise 3: Gap-Fill Summary 
Fill in the blanks with appropriate vocabulary phrases from the list: 
(budget airlines, affordable travel options, environmental concerns, tourism 
growth, air travel demand) 
Cheap air travelling has increased significantly due to the rise of (1) 
__________, allowing millions of people to enjoy (2) __________. As a 
result, many countries have experienced rapid (3) __________, which 
benefits local economies. However, this trend has also raised serious (4) 
__________, particularly regarding pollution and **carbon emissions**. 
Moreover, the growing (5) __________ places pressure on airports and 
airline infrastructure.
